item.title: Super Bowl 2026: Bad Bunny drew eyes to a boring game, but NBC did its best
item.description: Mike Tirico and Cris Collinsworth did a solid job with a game that fell flat.

item.title: Sam Darnold wins Super Bowl championship right where he revived his career with San Francisco
item.description: On the sideline of Levi's Stadium two seasons ago, Sam Darnold patiently paid his dues behind Brock Purdy as San Francisco's backup quarterback and soaked up every ounce of knowledge he could from the coaches.

item.title: Super Bowl 2026: Sam Darnold lives up to Jets' hype at last, just with the Seattle Seahawks instead
item.description: It took longer than the Jets or any of his other stops could wait, but Sam Darnold's belief in himself was rewarded Sunday.

item.title: Derick Hall's strip-sack opens the way to Seahawks' second title
item.description: The Seahawks had throttled the New England Patriots all game but still had only managed a 12-0 lead in a tight game when linebacker Derick Hall made the play that would open the way for Seattle to claim its second title.

item.title: Patriots' Maye turns ball over 3 times while hounded by Seahawks' defense in Super Bowl loss
item.description: Drake Maye was a dependable and steadying force for the New England Patriots this season.

item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo is yet to win a major trophy since joining Al-Nassr.

item.title: Kenneth Walker III becomes 1st running back to win Super Bowl MVP in 28 years
item.description: Kenneth Walker III is running into free agency with a Super Bowl MVP.

item.title: Somalia welcomes its first bowling alley as the middle class and diaspora returnees grow
item.description: Somalia is showing signs of revival from decades of conflict, welcoming its first bowling alley in the capital, Mogadishu.

item.title: Puerto Rico stops for 13 minutes to applaud history and bask in Bad Bunny's glow
item.description: For many Puerto Ricans in San Juan and beyond, the Super Bowl lasted all of 13 minutes.
